candidate_reports.remark: A tree was downed just west of Mount Vernon near Highway 39 and V highway. The Missouri ag site weather station measured a 50mph wind gust with this storm.
Trees down in the vicinity of the Dewey Short Visitor Center.
Table Rock State Park reported several large limbs and trees down throughout the park. Time estimated from radar.
A 63 mph wind gust was measured at Branson Fire Station number 4.
Several power poles were broken and lines were down just southwest of El Dorado Springs.
A public weather station measured a 65mph wind gust just off Highway 54 west of the Cedar county line.
Several trees and powerlines were down near HH highway and 700 road. A trailer home slid off its blocks in this area as well.
Reports of barn damage in the Appleton City area.
Delayed Report. A large outbuilding was destroyed_ with an additional small outbuilding and gazebo damaged. Several wooden boards from the outbuilding blew onto the roof of a home_ causing roof damag
